# Cheerplex Football Prediction, Curated Decimal Odds & Jackpot Analysis

> Cheerplex (cheerplex.co.ke) is a premier Kenyan sports analytics platform and quantitative research lab delivering daily football predictions, multi-tier decimal odds accumulators, Kenyan pool jackpot permutations (SportPesa, Betika, Mozzart), audited historical strike rates, and automated Safaricom M-Pesa STK verification.

## Core Capabilities & Prediction Services

- [Cheerplex Sure Tips & Curated Decimal Odds](https://cheerplex.co.ke/cheerplex-sure-tips-and-odds/): Mathematically validated 2+, 3+, 5+, 7+, and 10+ multiplier slips combining low-variance banker picks with instant bookmaker booking codes and automated Safaricom M-Pesa delivery.
- [Yesterday's Verified Results Ledger](https://cheerplex.co.ke/football-predictions-yesterday): Audited historical strike rates and settled match results with 100% transparent score logs.
- [Jackpot Tips and Analysis](https://cheerplex.co.ke/cheerplex-jackpots-predictions-and-tips): Comprehensive predictions and bonus combinations for SportPesa Mega Jackpot (KES 385M+), SportPesa Midweek, Betika Midweek (KES 15M), and Mozzart Super Grand (KES 200M).
- [VIP Packages](https://cheerplex.co.ke/vip-packages): Exclusive algorithmic multibets dispatched instantly via M-Pesa STK Push and WhatsApp.
- [Contact Support](https://cheerplex.co.ke/contact-us): 24/7 customer care and payment support desk via phone/WhatsApp (+254 740 841 375).

## Editorial & Research Standards

- **Primary Analyst**: John K. Mwangi (Senior Quantitative Sports Analyst, Nairobi Sports Analytics Lab).
- **Timezone**: All kickoff schedules and countdown timings are strictly synchronized to East Africa Time (EAT, UTC+3).
- **Responsible Gaming**: Cheerplex strictly promotes responsible gaming for adults 18+ only. Gaming involves risk; never wager capital required for essential living needs. Help line: 0800 724 990 (Kenya Betting Control and Licensing Board).
